knowledge:
- key_parameters: bin.length=smoothing parameter over the set of reads (default 20) used in compHists ;; whichPos=fragment position from which histograms are computed ('Left.p', 'Right.n', or 'Center') ;; contrast=contrast specification (e.g., 'byCondition' or custom list) in setContrast ;; dist.method=distance method (e.g., 'MMD') in compDists and compPvals ;; Peak.id=specific peak identifier for plotting in plotPeak and plotDISTS4Peak
- alternatives: DESeq2 (count-based testing, preferred when shape differences are not expected or when only total abundance changes matter) ;; DiffBind (count-based testing, preferred for standard differential binding analysis without shape considerations) ;; MMDiff (older version of the package, MMDiff2 is preferred for better stability, speed, and Shiny integration)
- when_to_use: Use when analyzing ChIP-Seq data where differences in peak shape (e.g., transcription factor binding or histone modification profiles) are expected or important, rather than just overall read count differences.
- pitfalls: Requires position-sorted and indexed BAM files ;; Requires pre-defined regions of interest (e.g., MACS2 called peaks) in GRanges format ;; Running compPvals without replicates will trigger a warning ("no replicates given for group2") and may affect statistical robustness.

workflows.name: chipseq_shape_diff_analysis
workflows.intent: Detect statistically significant differences in ChIP-Seq read enrichment profiles (peak shapes) between different conditions.
input: sampleSheet.csv (CSV file detailing paths to different samples)
peaks.GRanges (GenomicRanges object summarizing the peaks/regions of interest)
sorted_indexed.bam (Position-sorted and indexed BAM files for ChIP-Seq samples and inputs)
workflows.stages: 1. Initialize metadata and DBAmmd object (DBAmmd) ;; 2. Set regions of interest (setRegions) ;; 3. Retrieve peak reads from BAM files (getPeakReads) ;; 4. Estimate fragment centers (estimateFragmentCenters) ;; 5. Compute peak histograms (compHists) ;; 6. Compute pairwise distances between samples (compDists) ;; 7. Set experimental contrast (setContrast) ;; 8. Compute p-values for differential shape testing (compPvals) ;; 9. Report and visualize results (reportResults, plotDists, plotPeak, plotDISTS4Peak, runShinyMMDiff2)
workflows.code:
ExperimentData <- list(genome='BSgenome.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm9', dataDir=system.file("extdata", package="MMDiffBamSubset"), sampleSheet="Cfp1.csv")
MetaData <- list('ExpData' = ExperimentData)
MMD <- DBAmmd(MetaData)
data("Cfp1-Peaks")
MMD <- setRegions(MMD,Peaks)
MMD <- getPeakReads(MMD)
MMD <- estimateFragmentCenters(MMD)
MMD <- compHists(MMD, bin.length=20, whichPos="Center")
MMD <- compDists(MMD, dist.method = "MMD", run.parallel = FALSE)
MMD <- setContrast(MMD,contrast='byCondition')
MMD <- compPvals(MMD,dist.method='MMD')
plotDists(MMD, dist.method='MMD',whichContrast=1, diff.method='MMD.locfit', bUsePval=FALSE, th=0.1, title=NULL, what=3, xlim=NULL,ylim=NULL,Peak.IDs=NULL, withLegend=TRUE)
res <- reportResults(MMD)
Peak.ids <- names(res)
plotPeak(MMD, Peak.id=Peak.ids[1], NormMethod=NULL,plot.input = FALSE, whichPos="Center",whichContrast = 1)
plotDISTS4Peak(MMD,Peak.id=Peak.ids[1],dist.method='MMD', whichContrast=1,Zoom=TRUE)
runShinyMMDiff2(MMD)
